words.ex: Contrastive Multiview Coding
Humans view the world through many sensory channels
the long-wavelength light channel, viewed by the left eye
the high-frequency vibrations channel, heard by the right ear
Each view is noisy and incomplete
important factors, such as physics, geometry, and semantics
physics, geometry, and semantics, tend to be shared between all views
We investigate the classic hypothesis
a powerful representation is one that models view-invariant factors
